## Motivation

`gh issue create` and `gh pr create` support `-e`/`--editor`, which opens the user's configured editor for writing the title and body. The corresponding `edit` commands did not offer the same shortcut, so users who wanted to update an issue or pull request body in their editor had to either go through the interactive field-selection prompts first or provide the full body inline with `--body` or `--body-file`.

## Approach

This adds `-e`/`--editor` to both `gh issue edit` and `gh pr edit`.

When editor mode is enabled, the command:

- fetches the current title and body for the issue or pull request
- opens the configured editor with the current title on the first line and body below it
- updates the title and body from the edited content
- skips the interactive field-selection prompts
- uses the same `InitEditorMode` and `TitledEditSurvey` flow used by create commands

The flag also respects the existing `prefer_editor_prompt` configuration, so config-enabled editor mode behaves consistently with `gh issue create` and `gh pr create`.

## Validation and constraints

- `--editor` is mutually exclusive with `--body` and `--body-file`
- `gh issue edit --editor` does not support editing multiple issues at once
- editor mode does not fetch shared metadata options that are only needed by field-selection prompts

## Tests added

- flag parsing for `--editor`
- validation for `--editor` with `--body` and `--body-file`
- validation for `gh issue edit --editor` with multiple issues
- `prefer_editor_prompt` behavior for edit commands
- editor-mode integration paths for issue and pull request edits
